item.elsewhere.hacksilver.desc1: Cut silver ring pieces, the plunder of far landings, weighed rather than counted.
item.elsewhere.hacksilver.desc2: Spend them with the Silver-Weigher of a liberated Hrafnholt town.
item.elsewhere.hrafnholt_iron_crown.desc: Wolf-Rally: 8 percent less damage taken while a tamed wolf is within 16 blocks.
Plus 1 percent per Lord Seal you carry, up to 12 percent.
As good as netherite on armor and knockback, one toughness less.
item.elsewhere.hrafnholt_raven_banner.de: Plant it: Speed I for 30 seconds to you and your allies within 16 blocks.
One banner per player; it burns down after 30 seconds.
Sure-footed on ice and mountain scree, 10 percent faster on snow and powder snow, no powder-snow freeze.
Less toughness than netherite boots, and no knockback resistance.
item.elsewhere.hrafnholt_hearth_ward_mai: Immune to freezing, 10 percent less fire damage, 5 percent slower.
item.elsewhere.hrafnholt_skalds_rune_axe: The third hit on one target within 5 seconds deals 3 extra damage and more knockback.
One damage and 331 durability short of netherite.
Pelt-Rage: below 30 percent health, Strength I for 6 seconds, once per 2 minutes.
Two armor and two toughness under netherite.
item.elsewhere.hrafnholt_hornbow.desc1: Full draw in 0.85 seconds. Arrows slow what they hit for 2 seconds.
item.elsewhere.hrafnholt_hornbow.desc2: Shorter-lived than netherite gear, and no Infinity.
item.elsewhere.hrafnholt_raven_shield.de: A cosmetic shield-plaque painted with the raven.
item.elsewhere.hrafnholt_wolfpelt_blanke: A wolf-pelt blanket for a Wolf-Rider's horse, carried up from the longship landing.
Dyes a collar the brown of a forest wolf.
item.elsewhere.hrafnholt_seal_jarl.desc1: Wax and pine-resin, pressed by High Jarl Halvard Ironbrow.
